source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Παχώμιος του Κένο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Four Pachomii stand on this one day page and they are four entries and four men.** Pachomius the Great is an upgrade of the folder the corpus already holds; Pachomius the Hieromartyr, archbishop of Chernigov, is a new folder in this same batch; Pachomius the Anchorite is sent by his own page to 23 Μαρτίου, his day of repose, and is left alone here; and this one is the ascetic of the Transfiguration monastery by Lake Keno in the province of Kargopol. **The corpus's six other Pachomii are none of them his**: of Chios, of Gledin, Ionov, the companion of Papyrinus, the one kept on 6 May, and the Great. **The whole of what saint.gr prints is two sentences**, which are the whole of the life here. **No hymn, no year, no relics, no parents.**
